profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack Developer
profile.summary: Efficient Technical Lead with 14 years of experience maximizing efficiency and quality while designing Microservices frameworks and algorithms. Talented developer who performs system and change impact analysis to design appropriate technical solutions. Effective communicator who improves system designs by implementing numerous technologies throughout design process including C#, Java , ASP.NET MVC, Spring, Spring MVC, Angular.js, jQuery, Hibernate and Entity Framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Java and +1 skill

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed REST API to pull data from an internal search engine backed by Solr using Spring Boot.
- Developed a pipeline to import data into Apache Solr to allow full text search with different scoring methods.
- Created CI/CD pipelines using CloudFormation to deploy AWS resources (ECS, EKS, Lambda, SQS, SNS, Kinesis stream)
- Implemented SSO for angular application using OAuth OIDC.
- Developed the data pipeline to transfer data from on-premises cloud to AWS S3.
- Led a team of 4 engineers to automate data scientist workflows.
- Teamed with another engineer to quickly develop a tool for patent examiners in a month.
- Implemented a generic framework to capture the request/response for specific monitoring purposes using Spring Interceptor and AOP.
- Implemented custom Java Annotations to enable data authorization.
- Optimized the spark jobs to reduce the running time of offline processing jobs to 50%.
- Worked as full stack developer in large team to build Formulation search application using angular, java REST API.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Conducted requirements gathering and analysis, performed change impact analysis.
- Developed complex user stories such as payment processing and compensation calculation from FE  to BE.
- Implemented the store procedure to process payments and create Westpac file.
- Reviewed codes and technical solutions.
- Mentored new team members on technical requirements of project.

positions.title: Senior Technical Manager
positions.description:
- Participated in Architecture and Design review meeting for various .NET and Java projects
- Provided technical measurements to ensure the quality of code (Sonar quality metrics, CI/CD)
- Solved complex technical issues in .NET projects (performance optimization, code refactoring, ...)

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
- Managed .NET projects about Taxation and Health Care using full waterfall life-cycle
- Gathered and Analysed requirements of projects
- Reviewed Architecture of projects and provide Details Design documents
- Performed code reviews for team members
- Coached new team members
- Developed some parts of the projects (Coding, Unit Testing) using ASP.NET, WPF, NHibernate, EF, 
WCF

positions.title: Software Engineer | Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on several .NET and Java projects throughout full SDLC: requirement analysis, coding, testing and deployment to production.
Used various technologies: WinForm, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, NHibernate, EJB, Spring, Struts, Spring MVC, JDBC, Hibernate and Webservices.

educations.schoolName: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology
